observations: Photo 0 shows a black and silver 4-burner gas cooker with an oven door open, revealing a single oven rack and interior. The front panel has four control knobs. The top surface has four burners with black grates. The oven door has a glass window with a silver decorative pattern.

Photo 1 shows the same cooker from a top-down angle, with the oven door closed. The top surface has four burners and four control knobs. The oven door has a glass window with a silver decorative pattern. The cooker is placed on a tiled floor, partially wrapped in plastic.
The cooker appears to be in used condition with some visible scratches and wear on the top surface and front panel. The oven interior is clean and appears to be in good condition.
No brand or model name is visible on the cooker in either photo.
The seller claims it is a 'Standing Gas Cooker with Oven and grill', but there is no grill visible in the photos.
